primary_purpose: Showcase a real-world engineering problem and its quantifiable solution
required_sections: HOOK: State the final impressive result (e.g., 'Reduced load time by 60%')
PROBLEM: The original pain point or bottleneck
OLD APPROACH: How it was being done before (The Anti-Pattern)
THE CHANGE: The architectural or tool shift that was implemented
RESULT: The quantifiable outcome (speed, cost, bug reduction)
LESSON: The core principle proven by this case study
tone_rules: Focus on the 'Why' behind the change, not just the 'What'
